verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt exists at docs.mozilla.ai, the site that hosts the llamafile docs. However, it is an organization-wide index, and the visible excerpt shows only any-llm entries, so llamafile coverage is not confirmed. A probe of the llamafile.md markdown page returned a 'Page Not Found' body despite HTTP 200, so per-page agent-readable markdown is not evidenced for llamafile. Missing for 10: confirmed llamafile entries in llms.txt, working markdown/agent-oriented versions of llamafile pages, independent corroboration of agent use.
